summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K on November 5, 2026, attaching a press release disclosing transactions by persons discharging managerial responsibilities under the HMRC-approved Share Incentive Plan. CEO Tadeu Marroco, Chief Marketing Officer Luciano Comin, and Research and Science Director James Murphy each purchased 3 ordinary shares of 25p at 45.325 per share (aggregate 135.98 each) on November 4, 2026, on the London Stock Exchange. This is a routine UK MAR PDMR notification mapped to a US Form 4 equivalent, with no special-situations mechanics and no risk-arb angle.
